caption:
Lulu leans on her elbows all day on site, and one morning the tip of her elbow has a soft, puffy lump.

There's a small cushion called a bursa at the point of the elbow. Leaning on it or knocking it often can make it swell.

Hybi's plan: cut back on leaning, wear an elbow pad for floor work, and use a wrapped ice pack for 10–15 minutes.

If it's red or hot, you have a fever, there's a cut nearby, or the swelling keeps growing, see your GP promptly as infection is possible. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
